quantities.label: Earthquake rupture (point source)
quantities.description: The global variable a ground-motion model conditions on. A BN node on the Event plate, so a fixed scenario and an uncertain one differ only in which function produces it.

quantities.label: Peak ground acceleration
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Peak ground velocity
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Spectral acceleration, T = 1.0 s, 5% damping
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Normalised ground-motion residual at one bridge
quantities.description: epsilon in ln IM = ln median + sigma * epsilon. Standard normal at each bridge, correlated between bridges. A node of its own so the spatial dependence is explicit in the BN, where observations could later condition it.

quantities.label: Network link open to traffic
quantities.description: 0 closed, 1 open. The one link-level state both system functions read.

quantities.label: Shortest travel time, origin to destination
quantities.description: +inf when no open route exists, so P(connected) = P(TravelTime < inf).

quantities.label: Maximum flow, origin to destination
quantities.description: In whatever unit the network's Edge.capacity is stated in; the network's assumptions name it.
